lines.t:
The <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c> used for a <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c>'s <c:ffff00>act<c>. It depends on the
type of act and isn't always just one. For an <c:ffff00>action<c>,
it is the {{part}} that has that action.

If the {{acting_part}} is <c:ffff00>destroyed<c> before the act is
completed (for example, during <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c>), the act is
interrupted and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> begins immediately,
lasting a fixed time regardless of the action's
<c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> stat.
